messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — I'm going to push a small overlay change to staging that renames some secret paths and updates a KMS alias. Need a quick gating check before I promote.

chris: which secret paths? any service impact? :eyes:

maria: moving from `/secrets/staging/service` -> `/secrets/staging/services/service` (plural). It's just a namespacing cleanup. Also updating KMS alias from `alias/redwood-stg` -> `alias/redwood-staging-v2`. No data re-encryption, just alias switch.

sophie: ok on the alias, but watch kustomize patch ordering. If the secret name changes we need the deployment patch to reference the new name or the pod will fail to mount. Did you update the overlays/staging kustomization?

maria: updated kustomization.yaml in `overlays/staging/` and added a manifest patch for `deployment.yaml`. planning to apply `kubectl apply -k overlays/staging` after tf apply.

tim: can you paste the terraform change? I'll run a quick `plan` in my account.

maria: here's the TF snippet I changed:
```
resource "aws_secretsmanager_secret" "service" {
  name = "secrets/staging/services/service"
}

resource "aws_kms_alias" "staging_alias" {
  name          = "alias/redwood-staging-v2"
  target_key_id = aws_kms_key.staging_key.key_id
}
```

chris: sounds fine. One ask: add a short preflight check script that confirms the new secret path resolves before we flip traffic. small `kubectl get` + `aws secretsmanager get-secret-value` check.

ryan: infra-bot flagged a potential drift on prod overlays earlier; let's make sure this change doesn't accidentally get promoted to prod via CI. Can we gate the promote with a label or manual approval step?

maria: yeah will add a `promotion: manual` annotation in `overlays/staging/kustomization.yaml` and open a release-gate PR for prod.

tim: running `terraform plan` now against the staging workspace. snippet of the plan:
```
+ aws_secretsmanager_secret.service (new)
+ aws_kms_alias.staging_alias (new)
```
No deletes. No replacements.

infra-bot: [alert] staging plan contains new secret resources. Ensure IAM principal used by staging pods has permission to read `secrets/staging/services/*`.

sophie: also check the Helm chart values that inject secret names — we have one chart that still references the singular path. I can grep and patch in a follow-up commit.

chris: LGTM from infra perspective if tim's plan is clean and we add the preflight. Will wait for the release-gate PR for prod.

maria: thanks — I'll: 1) push tf apply to staging after tim approves, 2) add the preflight script to `devops/bin/`, 3) open release-gate PR for prod with manual approval. tagging @ryan for the prod gate. :thumbsup:

ryan: noted. please ping me once the PR is up, I'll do the approval after the preflight verification.

maria: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infrastructure/pull/1234 — preflight included, kustomize patch order fixed. Applying in ~10m.

chris: thanks. keep an eye on rollout; if any CrashLoopDetected hit the canary, revert the k8s overlay not the tf secret change first.

maria: will do. ping here with any failures and I'll promote the revert. :rocket:
